title: Automation Engineer - Playwright and JavaScript Exp
description:
**Senior QA Automation Engineer -**

We’re looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer to build automated test coverage for our e-commerce platforms, embed automation throughout the development process, and carry out manual testing where needed.

* Design, write and maintain automated end-to-end tests for web and mobile storefronts
* Build and troubleshoot tests across multiple browsers, devices and locales, including cloud device grids (e.g. LambdaTest, BrowserStack, Sauce Labs)
* Create and maintain API-driven tests to validate backend behavior alongside the UI
* Investigate test failures, distinguish real bugs from flaky tests, and report issues clearly
* Extend and evolve the test automation framework (patterns, reliability, CI reporting)
* Mentor other engineers on automation best practices and collaborate with developers/product to improve testability and coverage
* Perform manual/exploratory testing as needed — for new features ahead of automation, edge cases, or releases where automated coverage isn't yet in place

**Must-have skills:**

* Strong JavaScript (Node.js) experience
* Hands-on expertise with a modern browser automation tool (e.g. Playwright, Cypress) and BDD frameworks (Cucumber/Gherkin)
* Solid understanding of e-commerce user flows (browsing, cart, checkout, account, returns)
* API testing experience — building requests, validating responses, using APIs for test data setup
* Experience running tests on cloud device/browser grids (e.g. LambdaTest, BrowserStack)
* Comfortable reading/writing SQL for test data verification
* Strong manual/exploratory testing skills alongside automation
* Git-based workflow and CI/CD familiarity

title: Senior Quality Engineer II
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
**Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Quality engineering leadership: Lead the QE strategy and drive end-to-end test automation across web, API, mobile, cloud, and AI-powered applications
* Automation framework development: Design, build, and maintain scalable automation frameworks using Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, and modern testing tools
* API and microservices validation: Build robust testing solutions using Rest Assured, Postman, contract testing, and service virtualization techniques
* Engineering standards: Establish automation best practices, coding standards, quality gates, and CI/CD testing integrations
* AI/GenAI validation: Develop validation frameworks for LLM response quality, accuracy, consistency, reliability, and responsible AI guardrails
* Data integrity: Perform backend and database validation to ensure accuracy and consistency across distributed systems
* Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Product, Architecture, Engineering, and DevOps teams to define quality strategy and release readiness criteria
* Shift-left quality: Drive adoption of shift-left testing, continuous testing, and automated regression practices across Agile teams
* Technical mentorship: Mentor QE engineers, conduct code reviews, and provide technical leadership on quality engineering initiatives
* Quality metrics: Measure and improve automation coverage, regression efficiency, release quality, and overall engineering productivity
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regard to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field
* 8+ years of experience in Quality Engineering, Test Automation, or Software Development Engineering in Test (SDET)
* 5+ years in Proven experience leading enterprise-scale automation programs and quality engineering initiatives
* 5+ years in solid hands-on expertise in automation framework design, API testing, CI/CD integration, and modern quality engineering practices
* 5+ years in Experience working with large-scale enterprise applications in domains such as Healthcare, Financial Services, Insurance, Banking, or Technology
* Proven excellent communication, stakeholder management, and technical leadership skills

**Preferred Qualifications**

* AI/GenAI Testing and Validation, LLM Evaluation and Prompt Testing
* MCP-based Agent Testing, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, Claude, Cursor AI
* Appium Mobile Automation, AWS, Azure, or GCP Cloud Testing
* Performance Testing using JMeter or LoadRunner
* Dynatrace, SonarQube, Browser Stack, Sauce Labs
* Event-Driven Architecture and Distributed Systems Testing
* Cloud Migration Validation and Data Reconciliation Testing
* Healthcare Domain Exposure

+ Experience with healthcare datasets (claims, eligibility, prior authorization, provider directories)
+ Understanding of clinical or operational workflows (provider calls, documentation, adjudication steps)
+ Awareness of healthcare data sensitivity and HIPAA‑like compliance expectations
+ Ability to design, develop, and deploy AI-powered solutions using no-code, low-code, and advanced platforms, translating business needs into scalable applications that enhance products, workflows, and decision-making

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone - of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income - deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Lead, Tech (QTE)
company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
We are looking for a Lead, Tech to join the Quality and Test Engineering group based in the firm’s office in Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Gurugram. The Quality and Test Engineering (QTE) team manages the entire firm’s quality mandate and delivers quality product releases with deep integration in the software development cycle, focusing on functional correctness, scalability, and performance. Our prime motivation is to mature the software development cycle by bringing robust test-engineering practices, automation, tooling, and quality product releases.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
In this position, you will be responsible for developing automation tools/frameworks, understanding the domain, testing and automating complex projects, managing and mentoring a small group of test engineers, and driving innovation by improving on or introducing new tools/processes to improve efficiency and quality. Additionally, you will also collaborate closely with our business domain from a testing perspective. This includes involvement with various asset classes that the firm trades in, working with our state-of-the-art trading systems, exchange connectivity, pricing/forecasting models, and ensuring that our business-critical processes and workflows function exactly as intended. To elaborate further, you will focus on productivity through automation and tooling, developing end-to-end functional and integration test-case scenarios with an exceptional emphasis on the business domain, owning end-to-end QTE processes, and release planning. Furthermore, you will also have to exhibit leadership in test-case development, coordinate test-plan reviews, and generate repeatable test procedures.
  
  
**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
**Basic qualifications:**

* 6 to 8 years of relevant work experience
* The ability to rapidly learn complex domains and model workflows; translate requirements into test strategy
* Experience in building and improving test processes with an increased focus on business context
* Experience validating distributed/microservices systems and event driven workflows
* Experience working with a high-level, object-oriented programming language like Java/C++
* Exposure to scripting languages like Bash/Python
* Knowledge of unit testing frameworks like jUnit, TestNG, and API test automation
* Exposure to UI stacks like React/Redux
* Working experience in UNIX or one of its flavors
* Familiarity with performance/reliability testing and basic observability

Interested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Linkedin/LeasTechSDEMay24
  
  
We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender-neutral return-to-work initiative.
  
  
Members of the D. E. Shaw group do not discriminate in employment matters on the basis of sex, race, colour, caste, creed, religion, pregnancy, national origin, age, military service eligibility, veteran status, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or any other protected class.

title: Applied AI Platform Engineer (Performance Engineer) - Lead SDET I
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Applied AI Platform Engineer (Performance Engineer) - Lead SDET I**
**Role Overview:**
As an Applied AI Platform Engineer (Performance Engineer) - Lead SDET I , you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands-on approach to building the platforms, tooling, accelerators, and frameworks that other engineering teams build on. Your expertise will be pivotal in delivering platform capabilities that delight the engineers who depend on them, while driving tangible leverage and value across Deloitte’s AI engineering investments. You will leverage your extensive engineering craftsmanship and advanced proficiency across platform engineering, distributed systems, and modern AI/ML and Data infrastructure, consistently demonstrating your exemplary track record in delivering high-quality, reusable, outcome-focused solutions. The ideal candidate will be a role-model leader and mentor, collaborating with cross-functional teams to design, build, and operate the enabling layer for AI engineering at scale.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for engineering-leverage and adoption outcomes. Build platform capabilities that solve recurring problems once, well, for many teams—reducing per-team build and operate toil while ensuring consistency and compliance by default through high-quality, lean designs and implementations.
* Serve as the technical advocate for the platform as a product, ensuring capability integrity, feasibility, and alignment with the needs of the engineering teams who consume it. Lead requirement discovery with consuming teams, low-level architecture and component design of platform services, frameworks, and the AI control plane, and their development, testing, integration, and support.
* Maintain accountability for the integrity of the platform architecture and for the enterprise tech-stack conformance baseline that engineering teams build against. Manage platform dependencies, code design, implementation, the data and policy-as-code enforcement layers, and the OpenTelemetry-based instrumentation substrate—building capabilities that are operable, instrumented, performant, and drift-resistant by design, to the production standards set by SRE. Stay hands-on, self-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks. Create technical specifications, codify recurring patterns into reusable components and golden paths, and write high-quality, supportable, scalable code and review code of other engineers, mentoring them, to ensure all platform KPIs (adoption, reliability-by-design, and developer experience) are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams.
* Develop lean platform capabilities through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to solve the real needs of consuming engineering teams. Engage with those teams before, during, and after delivery to ensure the right capability is delivered at the right time—and adopted, not shelved.
* Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, delivering platform capabilities as lean, adoption-validated increments rather than big-bang builds, and keeping them supportable and maintainable.
* Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional partners: engineering, SRE, security and risk, data governance, and engineering leadership and architecture. Integrate their constraints into the paved roads so that the secure, compliant, and reliable path is the easy path. Deliver capabilities that are admissible-by-design and submit them for admission, co-defining service-level objectives with SRE, who set production standards and own the admission decision. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation.
* Possess deep expertise in platform engineering and modern AI/ML infrastructure—internal developer platforms, MLOps/LLMOps, model serving, retrieval and vector infrastructure, eval and observability tooling, policy-as-code, container orchestration, IaC, and CI/CD at platform scale—including AI and Agentic SSDLC to deliver self-service, governed capabilities with full automation from discovery to production to operations and all quality checks through the SSDLC lifecycle. Be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize platform solutioning and delivery. Demonstrate strong understanding of the full lifecycle of platform and product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning.
* Quickly acquire domain knowledge of the enterprise data estate and the AI use-case patterns the platform must serve. Translate the needs of engineering teams, reference architectures, and governance requirements into reusable frameworks, the data platform, and governance-as-code enforcement. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff.
* Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives.
* Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions.

**The team:**
US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte’s primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte’s success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world’s largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.
  
  
**The successful candidate will possess:**

* Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care.

**Required Qualifications:**

* A bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, machine learning, or related discipline. Experience is the most relevant factor.

Hands On experience with Performance Engineering is important.
  
  

* 10 + years of software and platform engineering experience with most of the following: Angular, React, NodeJS, Python(Mandatory), , C#, .NET, Java, Rust, SQL/NoSQL, PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, LangFuse, Terraform, as well as unit, integration, and end-to-end testing frameworks & tools, specifically BDD, Gherkin, Cucumber, Playwright, and Selenium.
* 3+ years of experience designing, building, and operating AI/ML platform or infrastructure, with hands-on experience across building tooling for MLOps/LLMOps, model serving, retrieval and vector infrastructure, and eval/observability instrumentation for LLM integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source models).
* 3+ years of experience with cloud-native engineering on any of the cloud hyperscalers such as Azure, AWS, or GCP—including their AI/ML services such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Vertex AI—as well as container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker), Big Data, Databricks, CI/CD at platform scale, and distributed systems.
* 1+ years of experience establishing engineering standards and golden paths, including actively leading, mentoring, and guiding team members in the adoption and continuous improvement of these standards, treating the platform as a product.
* Prior experience with AI control-plane and agent-runtime patterns: model/LLM gateway, A2A and MCP integration, agent runtimes (e.g., Google ADK, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore), guardrails (PII redaction, prompt-injection, content, tool permissioning/tool-RBAC), policy-as-code, and multi-tenant isolation.
* Prior experience with enterprise data platform engineering: data pipelines, self-service and data-product enablement, governance-as-code enforcement, and metadata/lineage.
* Prior software engineering experience with the understanding of Business Context Diagrams (BCD), sequence/activity/state/entity relationship/data flow diagrams, OOP/OOD, data structures, algorithms, and code instrumentations, and AI-augmented spec-driven development.
* Prior experience using methodologies & tools such as XP, Lean, DevSecOps, SRE, ADO, GitHub, SonarQube, and ArgoCD to deliver high-quality platforms and products rapidly.

**Other:**

* Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and products you build.
* Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

title: Quality Automation - Manager
description:
The Opportunity
  
  
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
  
  
**We Are**
A Quality Engineering practice that helps clients move from late-stage testing to continuous quality, efficiency, and resilience. We embed with product, engineering, and architecture teams, apply modern automation and AI-enabled testing, and take quality work from experiment into operational delivery at enterprise scale.
  
  
**You Are**
A hands-on SDET and quality leader with 12+ years in test automation and software quality engineering. You write and review automation, set and execute the quality strategy for your program, and coach a team while remaining technically engaged. You are comfortable in global, collaborative delivery environments and you care about embedding quality across the full software development lifecycle — not only at the end of a sprint.
  
  
The Work
  
  
You will lead quality for complex application delivery: partnering with product, development, and architecture teams; defining and executing a modern test strategy; and applying AI-enabled approaches where they deliver measurable value. You will take accountability for your team's delivery outcomes, technical direction, and continuous improvement, acting as both a technical lead and a client-facing quality partner.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Quality Strategy & Leadership**

* Define and lead end-to-end quality for your program, including early validation, risk-based testing, and continuous testing.
* Own quality strategy, test planning, estimation, execution governance, defect management, and release-readiness assessment across your workstreams.
* Establish the appropriate balance of unit, API, UI, integration, regression, and exploratory testing based on product risk and architecture.

**SDET & Custom Application Quality**

* Lead the design, development, and enhancement of automation frameworks and validation components — not test cases alone.
* Design, implement, and scale maintainable automation frameworks for web applications and services, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and performance.
* Build UI, API, and where required mobile automation using Playwright and comparable tools such as Appium and REST Assured.
* Partner with developers to improve unit-test coverage, testability, coding standards, and shift-left quality practices.

**AI-Enabled Testing & Innovation**

* Use AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor and agentic test automation solutions to accelerate test design, implementation, maintenance, and analysis responsibly.
* Apply GenAI tooling (for example GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini) to improve test design, code generation, debugging, and root cause analysis.
* Evaluate emerging AI-enabled testing tools through controlled proofs of concept and recommend adoption based on measurable value, security, accuracy, and maintainability.

**DevSecOps & CI/CD Integration**

* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and define quality gates that provide fast, reliable feedback.
* Embed automated testing into delivery pipelines such as GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps, covering version control and artifact management.

**Cross-Platform Quality Deliver**
y
  
  

* Lead testing across web, API, and mobile (iOS/Android) layers as the engagement requires.
* Apply contract testing, test-data management, service virtualization or mocking, and observability practices.

**Client Engagement & Advisory**

* Partner with client and business stakeholders to shape quality strategy and support transformation initiatives.
* Facilitate workshops and deliver pragmatic quality solutions in ambiguous or evolving delivery environments.

**Team Leadership & Delivery Accountability**

* Manage, mentor, and develop a high-performing quality engineering team, local or distributed, while remaining technically engaged.
* Own your team's delivery outcomes and guide day-to-day technical decisions.
* Coach team members, set technical direction, review automation code, and promote continuous learning and engineering discipline.

**Cross-Team Collaboration**

* Collaborate across product, development, architecture, DevOps, security, and business teams to resolve dependencies and embed quality throughout the delivery lifecycle.

**Continuous Improvement & Capability Building**

* Improve test coverage, automation maturity, and delivery efficiency over time.
* Champion quality engineering best practices, reusable standards, automation patterns, and shared assets that build team capability.

**Reporting & Insigh**
ts
  
  

* Produce clear test outcome reports covering execution status, coverage, defect trends, residual risk, release recommendations, and improvement actions.
* Track meaningful quality metrics and deliver dashboards that identify systemic issues, improve predictability, and reduce escaped defects.

**Security, Accessibility & Compliance**

* Embed secure, accessible, and compliant quality practices into delivery, including in regulated environments such as financial services, public sector, and healthcare.

What You'll Need
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related discipline.
* 12+ years of experience in test automation, SDET, or software quality engineering roles, with demonstrated ownership of complex automation programs.
* Proven experience leading quality engineering teams, managing priorities, mentoring engineers, and influencing delivery outcomes.
* Hands-on coding proficiency in at least one of TypeScript, JavaScript, C#, Python, or Java, with experience building automation frameworks.
* Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, clean-code principles, reusable framework design, version control, and code reviews.

title: Sr Quality Engineer
description:
Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties.
  
  
At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day - building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with entrepreneurial speed, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset.
  
  
As we continue to scale our global platform, the Senior Quality Engineer will play a critical role in embedding quality across Supply Chain, FinTech/Payments, and ERP platforms throughout the software delivery lifecycle.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a hands-on Senior Quality Engineer to independently own testing activities and strengthen quality across our Supply Chain, FinTech/Payments, and ERP platforms. Working closely with software engineers and product managers, this role identifies risks early, improves testability, and embeds quality into requirements, design, development, and release practices. The Senior Quality Engineer delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights.
  
  
**How Will You Drive Impact**
Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes.
  
  
Team & Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams)
  
  

* Partner with development and product teams during refinement and design to challenge ambiguous requirements, define testable acceptance criteria, and identify edge cases and integration risks before implementation begins.
* Contribute to shared QE standards, review automation code for test design and maintainability, and mentor teammates on continuous testing, shift-left, and AI-assisted testing practices.
* Collaborate with developers on appropriate unit, component, API, and integration coverage to drive shift-left and continuous testing practices across the team.

Fan & Customer Impact (Obsessed with Fans)
  
  

* Build end-to-end automated tests for critical business journeys including order, fulfillment, payment, and ERP/finance posting flows to protect reliability for end customers.
* Perform focused exploratory and manual testing for complex workflows, boundary conditions, and scenarios requiring human judgment to catch issues before they reach production.
* Validate data accuracy and consistency across services, databases, and integrated systems — including reconciliation checks — to ensure customers experience accurate, trustworthy transactions.
* Define, maintain, and report quality metrics and dashboards covering defect trends, escaped defects, and release readiness to support confident delivery decisions.

Innovation & Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)
  
  

* Apply LLMs and AI-assisted or agent-based (including MCP-based) workflows to test scenario generation, test data creation, automation implementation, maintenance, and failure triage, reviewing generated tests for correctness and meaningful assertions.
* Test AI/LLM-powered features where applicable, validating output quality and behavior with evals and non-deterministic testing approaches, and evaluate AI self-healing and visual testing tools for fit.
* Investigate flaky tests, diagnose failures using logs, API responses, and queries, and work with developers on root causes and regression prevention to continuously improve pipeline reliability.
* Contribute experience in performance, resilience, and security testing for critical flows, bringing a proactive lens to systemic risk reduction.

Ownership & Execution (Determined & Relentless Mindset)
  
  

* Independently own test strategy, planning, estimation, test data, execution, defect triage, and quality reporting for the team — identifying dependencies and escalating risks early.
* Design, build, and maintain reusable automation frameworks and suites for APIs, web applications, integrations, and data validation, keeping coverage aligned with business risk and system changes.
* Integrate automated tests and actionable reporting into CI/CD pipelines, improving execution speed and reliability to maintain dependable regression feedback at every stage of delivery.
* Provide regular, evidence-based updates on testing progress, blockers, residual risks, and release readiness to support delivery decisions and continuous improvement.

AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY
  
  
We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to:
  
  

* Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes
* Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance
* Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working
* Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement

**Required Qualifications**
CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING
  
  

* 8+ years of experience in software quality engineering, with demonstrated senior-level technical depth and independent ownership of testing in an Agile engineering team.
* Hands-on experience designing and maintaining automation frameworks and reliable test suites, with strong programming skills in Python and/or TypeScript (Java or Go also valued) and comfort working across languages.
* Practical experience using AI in test automation workflows — including LLM-assisted test and test-data generation, agentic/MCP-based automation, testing AI/LLM-powered features, or AI self-healing and visual testing tools — with concrete examples of improved coverage, faster delivery, or reduced maintenance effort and the ability to explain how generated tests were reviewed and validated.
* Strong understanding of shift-left testing, continuous testing, risk-based test planning, and the appropriate balance of unit, component, integration, and end-to-end coverage, combined with experience with API automation for REST and/or gRPC services and web automation frameworks such as Playwright (preferred), Selenium, or WebdriverIO.
* Proficiency in SQL and relational databases for test data preparation and validation, with the ability to investigate data consistency issues across integrated systems and diagnose failures using logs and API responses.
* Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, working with Git-based code review (GitHub/GitLab), and testing in cloud environments such as AWS or GCP, alongside familiarity with test case management and API testing tools such as TestRail and Postman.
* Strong analytical and communication skills with the ability to collaborate closely with developers and product managers, prioritize independently, and communicate quality risks with supporting evidence; prior experience in Supply Chain Management (SCM) and/or FinTech/Payments domains, or with ERP systems and their integrations, is strongly preferred.

WORK LOCATION
  
  
Hybrid: The primary place of performance of this role is the Company's office located Hyderabad, India, subject to the Company's current hybrid work policy. This role currently requires in-office presence

title: QAE II, Amazon Business Operations, Amazon Business Operations
description:
**Description**
Amazon Business customers place orders that arrive by the pallet: a school district ordering 2,000 chairs, a contractor ordering 900 boxes of fasteners, a hospital restocking a floor. Amazon Business Operations builds the systems that get those orders sourced, consolidated and delivered on the date the customer asked for. When one of these orders goes wrong it does not just degrade a page: a dock appointment is missed, an operator recovers the order by hand, and an enterprise reconsiders how much of its spend comes to Amazon.
  
  
We are building a new engineering team in Hyderabad dedicated to bulk fulfilment, and this is its first quality engineering hire. There is no existing test practice to inherit. You will decide what good looks like for every service the team launches.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As a Quality Assurance Engineer on this team, you will:
  
  
Own feature quality end to end: design test plans, execute test cases, run bug triage, coordinate with product and engineering stakeholders, and give release sign-off.
  
  
Build and maintain automated test coverage inside the team's framework so that regression testing does not grow with the codebase.
  
  
Test operator-facing tooling and machine learning assisted decision flows, where correctness means the recommendation a human acts on is right, not only that the service returned a response.
  
  
Validate integrations with Amazon supply chain and fulfilment systems, including the data correctness that inventory, transportation and delivery promises depend on.
  
  
Set the quality bar for a new team: definition of done, quality metrics, and production monitoring that catches problems before an operator does.
  
  
You will work directly with the engineers building the service, the product manager writing the requirements, and the Amazon Business Operations teams who use what you ship. If you want ownership of quality for a product line from its first commit, this is that role.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
You will sit with the engineers building the service, not apart from them. A typical day mixes writing and running test cases for the feature in the current sprint, extending automated regression coverage in the team's framework, and triaging yesterday's defects with the SDE who owns the code. You will review requirements with the product manager before a story enters the sprint, so acceptance criteria are testable rather than aspirational. You will spend time with the Amazon Business Operations teams who use the tooling, because they will tell you which failures actually hurt. Before a release ships, your sign-off is the gate.
  
  
**About The Team**
Amazon Business Operations builds the systems and processes behind business buying at Amazon, from quoting a large order to landing it on a customer's dock. This is a new engineering team inside it, dedicated to bulk fulfilment, and you are joining at the start. We work in small teams with direct ownership, we measure ourselves on what changed for the customer, and we expect engineers to argue about design in writing. Expect high autonomy, close contact with the operators and customers you build for, and problems that have not been solved anywhere in Amazon yet.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 4+ years of quality assurance engineering experience
* Experience in automation testing
* Experience in manual testing
* Experience as QA lead on medium to large sized projects
* Experience developing high quality test plans, test designs, test strategies, and test execution
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* Experience scripting or coding
* Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in gathering test requirements to create detailed test plans and defining quality metrics to measure product quality
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C++, or C# including object-oriented design
* Experience in penetration testing and exploitability-focused vulnerability assessment
* Knowledge of overall system architecture, scalability, reliability, and performance in a database environment
* Experience debugging, diagnosing, and troubleshooting complex, production software issues

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
**Future Talent: Platform Engineering (Talent Community – India)**
**Location:**
Bengaluru / Hyderabad
  
  
**Position Type:**
Future Opening – Talent Pipeline
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are continuously seeking exceptional
**Platform Engineers**
across India to help build and scale the foundational platforms that empower our engineering teams to deliver secure, reliable, and high-performing products at scale.
  
  
While we may not have an immediate opening today, this dedicated
**Platform Engineering Talent Pool**
enables us to engage with talented engineers early and connect them with future opportunities aligned to their expertise and career aspirations.
  
  
By joining our engineering community, you'll gain insight into our platform strategy, cloud transformation initiatives, developer experience programmes, and engineering culture. You'll also be among the first to move directly into advanced interview stages when a matching role becomes available.
  
  
**What You'll Do (When You Join Us)**
As a
**Platform Engineer**
, you'll design, build, and operate the platforms, tooling, and automation capabilities that power modern software delivery across the organisation.
  
  
**Build & Evolve Platforms**

* Design and develop scalable, self-service platform capabilities that improve developer productivity and accelerate software delivery.
* Build and maintain cloud-native platform solutions leveraging containerisation, orchestration, infrastructure automation, and platform services.
* Create reusable engineering standards, frameworks, and deployment patterns that enable consistency across teams.

**Automate & Optimise**

* Develop Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using modern automation tools and practices.
* Establish and enhance CI/CD pipelines to streamline build, test, release, and deployment processes.
* Improve platform reliability, scalability, security, and operational efficiency through automation and observability.
* Drive standardisation through platform engineering best practices, policy automation, and governance frameworks.

**Enable Engineering Excellence**

* Partner with Software Engineers, Architects, SREs, Security teams, and Product teams to build reliable engineering platforms.
* Improve developer experience through self-service tools, internal developer platforms, and engineering productivity initiatives.
* Participate in platform design reviews, architecture discussions, incident reviews, and continuous improvement activities.

**Operate & Support**

* Monitor platform health, availability, and performance across cloud and on-premises environments.
* Contribute to operational excellence through logging, monitoring, alerting, capacity planning, and resilience engineering practices.
* Support incident management, root cause analysis, and service reliability initiatives.

**Mentor & Share**

* Guide engineers on platform capabilities, automation practices, cloud adoption, and DevOps methodologies.
* Contribute to engineering communities, internal tech forums, and knowledge-sharing initiatives.

**What You'll Bring**
**Build With Purpose**
Define problems clearly, simplify complexity, and deliver measurable outcomes.
  
  
**Customer Driven**
Work backwards from developer and business needs. Build platforms that make engineering teams more effective.
  
  
**Technically Courageous**
Embrace complex infrastructure and platform challenges. Continuously innovate and improve.
  
  
**Learn and Be Curious**
Explore emerging cloud technologies, platform patterns, and engineering practices while sharing knowledge with others.
  
  
**Act as Owner**
Take accountability for platform reliability, security, scalability, and long-term sustainability.
  
  
**Lead with Data**
Use operational metrics, telemetry, and performance data to guide decisions and measure platform effectiveness.
  
  
**Dive Deep**
Investigate issues thoroughly, understand systems end-to-end, and solve problems at their root cause.
  
  
**Build Responsibly, Deliver Incrementally**
Prioritise secure, resilient, automated solutions while continuously iterating based on feedback and operational insights.
  
  
**Collaborate to Achieve**
Partner effectively across engineering, operations, security, and product teams to achieve shared outcomes.
  
  
**How We Hire**
Our hiring process is skills-focused and structured to be fair and consistent. Candidates may complete a technical assessment (Codility) followed by interview stages designed to evaluate technical skills, design thinking, and our Engineering Principles.
  
  
**Why Connect Now?**
**Skip the Line**
Members of this Platform Engineering talent community receive priority consideration when relevant opportunities become available.
  
  
**Exclusive Insights**
Gain access to engineering webinars, architecture roundtables, platform transformation updates, and technical leadership sessions.
  
  
**Career Alignment**
We connect you with opportunities aligned to your interests, whether they involve cloud engineering, DevOps, SRE, infrastructure automation, internal developer platforms, or platform architecture.
  
  
**How To Join**
Upload your CV along with a short note about:
  
  

* The platform engineering challenges you enjoy solving
* Your preferred areas of focus (Cloud, Kubernetes, Infrastructure Automation, DevOps, SRE, Developer Experience, Security Engineering, or Platform Architecture)

We will review your profile and connect for an informal conversation to better understand your experience, interests, and future career aspirations.

title: Software Development Engineer III
description:
At F5, we strive to bring a better digital world to life. Our teams empower organizations across the globe to create, secure, and run applications that enhance how we experience our evolving digital world. We are passionate about cybersecurity, from protecting consumers from fraud to enabling companies to focus on innovation.
  
  
Everything we do centers around people. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better. And it means we prioritize a diverse F5 community where each individual can thrive.
  
  
**What will you do?**
Our Software Development Engineer provides software development support by analyzing business requirements to design and develop appropriate systems solutions according to specifications. They provide technical expertise in evaluating, designing, developing, deploying, monitoring, and supporting systems and procedures that are cost-effective and improve work efficiency. Additionally, the Software Development Engineer partners with Solution Architects to ensure that the application meets company service level standards and roadmap requirements.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities will include:**

* Full-Stack Development: Design, develop, and maintain scalable systems, combining frontend development using React/Next.js with TypeScript and backend development with Java (Spring Boot, Hibernate) and additional backend languages like Node, Python, or Go.
* Backend Expertise with Java: Build high-performance, scalable backend systems using modern Java frameworks (Spring Boot, Hibernate). Ensure APIs, microservices, and integrations are robust, efficient, and secure.
* Cloud Services: Implement and maintain cloud-native applications on Azure or AWS, leveraging managed services such as computing, networking, databases (e.g., Postgres, DynamoDB, Cosmos DB), and object storage (e.g., S3, Azure Blob).
* Proficient in implementing robust testing strategies for Java applications using frameworks such as JUnit, TestNG, Mockito, Selenium, and Cucumber.
* Event-Driven Architecture: Design and implement event-driven systems using tools such as Solace, Kafka, or AWS SNS/SQS, ensuring real-time communication and asynchronous workflows.
* DevOps & CI/CD: Create and maintain CI/CD pipelines with tools like GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or Jenkins, streamlining deployment processes.
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Utilize IaC tools like Terraform, ARM, or Bicep to manage cloud configurations and provision reliable infrastructure.
* Containerization & Orchestration: Develop and deploy scalable containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes (e.g., AKS/EKS).
* AI-Driven Approaches: Improve products using AI tools, integrating AI-powered features such as predictive analytics or generative workflows into applications.
* Collaboration & Agile: Collaborate with architects, product owners, and business stakeholders in an Agile/Scrum environment, offering reliable LOE (Level of Effort) estimates and technical recommendations.
* Production Support & Operations: Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve issues in production, ensuring solutions meet performance, reliability, and security standards.
* Analyze and translate business requirements and acceptance criteria into functional and non-function system requirements
* Design reliable/scalable/reusable/future-proof technical solutions to the business requirements/specifications/acceptance criteria and can effectively present your technical solutions to the review board in the format of POC or flow diagrams.
* Write technical design documents when needed and document complex solutions to share with your peers
* Work with solution architects to craft a technical solution that meets the company’s service level standard, security requirement and minimizes the dependency of the upstream teams and the impact to the downstream teams

**Other Responsibilities**

* Responsible for upholding F5’s Business Code of Ethics and for promptly reporting violations of the Code or other company policies.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**What do you need to be successful in this role?**

* 6+ years building full-stack systems at scale
* Strong Experience in React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, Python, Go, Java
* Experience with responsive design and UI/UX best practices.
* Strong object-oriented programming skills.
* Hands-on experience with AWS (S3, DynamoDB, Aurora, Kinesis) and Azure (Blob Storage, CosmosDB, AKS). Proficient in utilizing compute, networking, and managed database solutions.
* CI/CD Tools: GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins
* Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates
* Experience automating deployments and streamlining workflows.
* Expertise in Docker containerization and Kubernetes (EKS, AKS) for deploying and scaling applications.
* Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, CosmosDB
* Additional Tools: Redis (caching), Elasticsearch (search), Kafka (eventing)
* Production-ready experience with monitoring, logging, and ensuring security in distributed systems.
* Tools: Logging/monitoring platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, and CloudWatch.
* Excellent communicator who translates product/customer needs into robust technical solutions.
* Leverages AI tools to boost team productivity — uses AI-assisted development and automation to create multiplier effects across the org.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent experience.
* Strong skills in communicating with different roles in a scrum team.
* Strong knowledge and working experience in object-oriented programming
* Excellent analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills

**Our values:**
At F5 we live and breathe our core values, Excellence, Integrity, Collaboration, Customer Loyalty, Profitable Growth, Innovation, Employee Success, and Diversity. We help each other achieve our goals, value the diversity of ideas different backgrounds can bring, emphasize teamwork over rock-stars, work hard and most of all have fun
  
  
The Job Description is intended to be a general representation of the responsibilities and requirements of the job. However, the description may not be all-inclusive, and responsibilities and requirements are subject to change.

**@myworkday.com)**
**.**

This policy applies to all aspects of employment, including, but not limited to, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, discipline, and termination. F5 offers a variety of reasonable accommodations for candidates. Requesting an accommodation is completely voluntary. F5 will assess the need for accommodations in the application process separately from those that may be needed to perform the job. Request by contacting accommodations@f5.com.

description:
**Company Overview:**
NationsBenefits is the leading provider of supplemental benefits, flex cards, and membernengagement solutions that partner with managed care organizations to provide innovative healthcare solutions designed to drive growth, improve outcomes, reduce costs, and delight members. Our comprehensive suite of innovative supplemental benefits, payments platform, and member engagement solutions help health plans deliver high-quality benefit to their members, addressing social determinants of health and improving member health outcomes and satisfaction. Pennsylvania, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, and India.
  
  
You might also like to know that NationsBenefits is also recognized as one of the fastest growing companies in America. We’re proud of how far we’ve come, and a career with us alsogives you growth opportunities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and execute performance, load, stress, endurance, and spike tests using Apache JMeter.
* Analyze application performance and identify bottlenecks across application, database, and infrastructure layers.
* Define performance testing strategies, workload models, and acceptance criteria based on business and non-functional requirements.
* Create reusable and maintainable JMeter test scripts for web applications, REST APIs, and microservices.
* Monitor application performance using APM and infrastructure monitoring tools during test execution.
* Analyze test results and prepare detailed performance reports with observations, root cause analysis, and recommendations.
* Collaborate with developers, DevOps, database administrators, and infrastructure teams to resolve performance issues.
* Integrate performance tests into CI/CD pipelines to support continuous performance testing.
* Validate system scalability, stability, and reliability under expected and peak workloads.
* Participate in performance tuning discussions and recommend improvements to application architecture and infrastructure.
* Maintain performance testing documentation, scripts, and test data.

**Required Skills**

* 4–6 years of experience in performance testing and engineering.
* Strong hands-on experience with Apache JMeter.
* Experience designing and executing load, stress, endurance (soak), and spike tests.
* Experience testing REST APIs, web applications, and microservices.
* Strong understanding of HTTP/HTTPS, WebSockets, and API performance testing.
* Experience analyzing server-side metrics such as CPU, memory, disk I/O, network utilization, and thread usage.
* Knowledge of SQL for database validation and performance analysis.
* Familiarity with application performance monitoring (APM) tools such as Dynatrace, AppDynamics, New Relic, Grafana, or Prometheus.
* Experience integrating performance tests into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI.
* Strong scripting knowledge for test parameterization, correlation, and custom logic using Groovy or BeanShell in JMeter.
* Experience with Git and version control.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

title: QA Engineering
description:
**The Opportunity: Build the future of Wealth**

In a fintech world obsessed with gamification and speculative betting, Endowus stands apart. We aren't here to build another trading app; we are building the financial infrastructure to help people achieve long-term life goals - retirement, education, and financial freedom.

**Headquartered in Singapore, we are the largest independent digital wealth platform in Asia**
. However, we are not a one-trick robo-advisor. We are a full-suite wealth platform spanning public equities, fixed income, private markets, and hedge funds. We provide clients with customized exposure—global, regional, or sectoral—across all their wealth (from liquid cash to pension savings) and for all their needs (from short-term cash management to long-term retirement planning).

Just six years after launch, we manage over US$10 Billion (~₹90,000 Crore) in assets for more than a quarter-million clients across Singapore and Hong Kong. We are a Series B company backed by global giants (Lightspeed, Illuminate, Prosus, EDBI, UBS), with ambitions to cover the entire region.

**This is not an 'offshore' support role.**
Our India team is a
**core product hub**
, operating on parity with our Singapore HQ. Engineers here drive end-to-end ownership of platform innovation. You won't just be testing code; you will be engineering the safety nets that allow us to move fast without breaking trust.

**The Role: Engineering Confidence**

Most companies treat QA as a final checkpoint. We treat it as an engineering discipline.

Our clients trust us with their life savings. "Move fast and break things" is not an option here. What we need is "Move fast and prove it's safe."

Here’s what you can look forward to in this role.

* **Engineer the Safety Net**
  : You will build and maintain scalable automation scripts that cover the entire stack - from Backend APIs (Scala/Akka) to Web (React) and Mobile (Flutter). You ensure our regression tests are reliable and fast.
* **Shift Quality Left**
  : You will collaborate with Product Managers and Developers before a line of code is written. You will review requirements for testability and ensure edge cases are caught during the design phase.
* **Pragmatic Quality**
  : While automation is our north star, we value thoughtful test planning and the human eye. You are willing to roll up your sleeves and perform manual exploratory testing because you know when to automate and when to test/investigate manually.
* **Drive CI/CD Velocity**
  : You will integrate your tests into our CI/CD pipelines. You ensure that our feedback loops are fast so developers can fix issues immediately.
* **Guardian of the Client Experience**
  : You will look beyond functional correctness. You will simulate real-world client behaviors to catch usability friction, performance lags, and data inconsistencies that automated checks might miss.

**Our Tech Stack**

* **Web Automation**
  : We use
  **Playwright**
  for high-speed, reliable end-to-end testing of our React applications.
* **Backend Automation**
  : We use
  **Cucumber-Scala**
  to test our distributed microservices (Scala/Akka) and ensure our domain logic holds up under pressure.
* **Mobile Automation**
  : We leverage
  **Maestro E2E**
  and flutter tests for our Dart/Flutter mobile apps.
* **Ops**
  : We are 100% cloud-native (AWS) and rely heavily on
  **CI/CD**
  to run your tests on every commit.

**Want to look under the hood?**
Read how we solve testing challenges on our Engineering Blog at
tech.endowus.com

**What Success Looks Like**

* **First 30 Days (Immersion)**
  : You understand our domain models and testing infrastructure. You have added a new regression test and performed manual testing for a new feature release.
* **First 90 Days (Ownership)**
  : You are actively writing automated tests for new features within the sprint. You have built a deep understanding of many domain flows and have plugged several gaps in our current test coverage.
* **First 6 Months (Impact)**
  : You now own the test planning & execution for major new initiatives and are actively elevating the quality of our platform with a “founder mentality”.

**What You Bring (Requirements)**

We care more about your engineering intuition than your ability to memorize APIs. However, this role requires a specific baseline:

**Must-Haves**
:

* **4+ Years of Test Engineering**
  : You have solid experience in automation. You are comfortable writing code to test code, but you also respect the value of manual validation.
* **Strong Coding Fundamentals**
  : You are proficient in at least one major language (
  **Java, Scala, TypeScript, or Python**
  ). You can read developer code to understand where a bug might be hiding.
* **Automation Framework Competence**
  : You have experience using and extending frameworks like
  **Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium**
  . You can write stable, maintainable scripts.
* **API Testing DNA**
  : You are comfortable testing microservices. You understand REST, JSON, and how to query a database (SQL) to verify test states.
* **Collaborative Mindset**
  : You don't wait for a "hand-off." You actively ask developers and PMs questions about implementation details to plan your tests better

**Nice-to-Haves**
:

* **Mobile Automation**
  : Experience testing Flutter or native apps using Appium or Maestro.
* **Performance Testing**
  : Experience with K6, Gatling, or JMeter.
* **FinTech Domain**
  : You understand financial concepts, ledgers, or high-security environments

**Why Endowus?**

* **Modern Stack, Serious Business**
  : You get to apply modern automation tools to mission-critical financial infrastructure. You get the intellectual depth of a top-tier private bank with the agility of a startup.
* **World-Class Engineering Talent**
  : You will work with colleagues from top product companies like Amazon, Google, Swiggy, Flipkart, Grab, and Meta. We bring together strong fintech DNA with the best of agile startup culture.
* **Career Growth with Upside**
  : We manage massive AUA ($10 billion and growing) with a lean, high-talent team (~85 in product engineering). This means high visibility, high impact, and significant ESOP upside in a company that is defining the category.
* **Leadership Pedigree**
  : Our leadership team brings experience from Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs, UBS, McKinsey, Bloomberg, Amazon, Alibaba, Grab, Shopee, Salesforce, and more.

**Why NOT Endowus?**

We want you to thrive here, which means we must be honest about the environment.

* **You prefer 100% Automation**
  : If you thrive best when writing code all day and prefer to minimize manual exploration with the product or learning the domain inside-out, our hybrid approach might not suit you.
* **You prefer a Centralized QA Structure**
  : If you prefer working in a dedicated QA team with clear hand-offs from developers, you might find our cross-functional team structure (Backend + Frontend + QA + PM + Design) challenging.
* **You prefer executing over planning**
  : If you do your best work when given a pre-written test plan to execute step-by-step, this role might be too broad. We need engineers who can look at a feature spec and derive the test strategy themselves.
* **You want 100% Remote**
  : We work in the office at least 3 days a week because we believe in the serendipity of in-person collaboration

**The Interview Process**

We respect your time and aim to be thorough yet efficient.

* Recruiter Screen (30 min): Quick alignment on role, stack, and mission.
* Online Coding Assessment (90 min): A hands-on coding challenge to assess your coding and scripting fundamentals along with Test planning
* Technical Deep Dive (90 min): Live coding and discussion. We focus on automation logic, framework usage, and how you approach manual vs. automated scenarios.
* System Design (60 min): We talk about test strategies for distributed systems, API testing, and data management.
* Culture & Values (60 min): Meeting with Leadership to ensure we are a match.

You will maintain technical continuity across the lifecycle, working with business stakeholders and multidisciplinary teams to shape the simplest viable solution, coordinate execution, make delivery trade-offs, remove blockers and contribute hands-on to critical components. The role combines enterprise solution engineering, applied AI/ML, GenAI, RAG and agents, integration, evaluation, MLOps/LLMOps, security, governance and production operations. * Bachelor’s degree with 10 - 12 years of experience in Computer Science, IT or related field OR

* Technical discovery, and value framing: Workflow analysis, intended-use definition, feasibility assessment, data and integration readiness, success measures, estimates, dependency mapping and technical go/no-go recommendations.
* Enterprise solution architecture and integration: End-to-end design across applications, APIs, services, data and knowledge flows, models, retrieval, agents, workflows, persistence, identity, security zones, enterprise systems and support boundaries.
* Applied AI/ML and GenAI engineering: Production Python and SQL; classical ML and NLP awareness; foundation-model integration, prompt and context management, RAG, structured output, provenance, citations, bounded tool use, permissions, recovery and human control.
* Evaluation, quality and regulated delivery: Representative evidence, baselines, gold sets, error taxonomies, expert adjudication, model and retrieval quality, task success, safety, latency, reliability, failure analysis, Responsible AI, privacy, validation, auditability and GxP controls.
* Cloud, DevSecOps and lifecycle operations: Cloud-native services, containers, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, versioning, observability, SLOs, staged release, rollback, incidents, disaster recovery, capacity, FinOps, runbooks and MLOps/LLMOps.

**Must-Have Skills**

* Proven ability to turn complex business problems into coherent technical designs, executable delivery plans, acceptance criteria and production-readiness evidence while coordinating multidisciplinary teams.
* Advanced capability in at least one role-defining pillar—Applied AI/ML, GenAI/RAG/agents, full-stack and integration engineering, or AI platform/MLOps—plus credible breadth across the production lifecycle.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Cloud, data and AI platforms: AWS, Bedrock or SageMaker, Databricks, Spark, Kubernetes, serverless or event-driven systems, infrastructure as code, MLflow, Airflow, Kubeflow, observability and FinOps.
* Full-stack, workflow and automation breadth: JavaScript or TypeScript, modern web applications, API gateways, distributed workflows, process automation, document or vision capabilities and human-AI review experiences.

title: Specialist, Quality Engineer
description:

At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.
  
  
**Role Summary**
**Specialist QA Engineer — Job Requirements**
We are seeking a Specialist QA Engineer to strengthen quality across web applications, APIs, and integrated services. The role requires hands-on API and performance testing, alongside test automation, observability practices, and CI/CD integration to help teams deliver reliable software at pace.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* Demonstrated experience in software quality engineering, including designing test strategies and translating requirements into clear, risk-based test coverage.
* Strong programming experience in at least one of: Java, JavaScript, or TypeScript, with the ability to build and maintain automated test code.
* Practical experience developing browser automation with Playwright and/or Selenium; able to create maintainable, reusable tests and troubleshoot failures.
* Experience applying the Page Object Model (POM) or an equivalent page/component abstraction to organize UI automation.
* Experience with BDD-style testing and Cucumber, including writing or maintaining readable feature scenarios and step definitions.
* Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub and tools such as Harness; familiarity with Rancher-based environments is an advantage.
* Hands-on experience designing and executing API tests for REST and SOAP services and validating integrations, including systems built with Mule or MuleSoft; able to verify functional behavior, error handling, and end-to-end flows across dependent services.
* Hands-on experience planning and executing performance and load tests using JMeter, analyzing results, identifying bottlenecks, and communicating performance risks and findings.
* Experience with database testing, including data validation and verification of application-to-database behavior; familiarity with Oracle Database and relational and non-relational database concepts.
* Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools such as Grafana, New Relic, and Splunk (or equivalent platforms) to investigate test and production issues.
* Experience using AI prompting to support QA work, such as generating or refining test scenarios, test data ideas, and defect-analysis summaries; able to validate AI-generated output for accuracy, security, and suitability before use.
* Familiarity with Jira for managing test-related work, tracking defects, and communicating status within a delivery team.
* Experience working within Agile methodologies, collaborating with cross-functional teams through planning, refinement, execution, and retrospectives.
* Strong defect investigation, root-cause analysis, test reporting, and communication skills; able to collaborate effectively with engineering, product, and operations teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building AI agents is a plus.
* Experience supporting test automation in containerized or Kubernetes environments, including deployments managed with Rancher.
* Experience combining UI, API, integration, and performance testing in a cohesive quality strategy.
* Familiarity with test data management, mocking/stubbing, parallel test execution, and reducing flaky tests.
* Experience contributing to continuous-delivery quality gates and release-readiness decisions.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Automated tests are maintainable, useful, and integrated into delivery pipelines.
* Test results provide actionable feedback, and defects are identified early with clear evidence and reproducible steps.
* Performance and observability signals are used to help teams diagnose risk and improve service reliability.

* Automation Tools: Hands-on expertise in Playwright and/or Selenium, REST API testing, and modern JavaScript/TypeScript or Python automation frameworks.
* AI-Assisted Testing: Working knowledge of LLMs and context design for QE use cases.
* Experience in providing AI-assisted solutions for functional, UAT, performance and security testing.
* AI Tooling: Experience applying AI tools for test case generation, code review support, and defect triage.
* Agentic Workflows: Understanding of agentic AI patterns to build autonomous test agents and end-to-end workflows.
* Integration: Ability to integrate AI solutions with existing business processes and enterprise IT infrastructure

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* Exposure to cloud ecosystems such as AWS and Azure.

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Bachelor’s Degree and a minimum of 12 + years of experience in Information Technology or Engineering.

title: Software Development Engineer II, Unified Auth SDK
description:
**Description**
UnifiedAuth is the authentication and authorization backbone for Amazon's service ecosystem. We secure service-to-service communication, ensuring that every call between Amazon services is authenticated and authorized against the right identity and policy. As Amazon's systems evolve toward autonomous agents, we provide agentic authentication and authorization — establishing verifiable identity and scoped, policy-governed access for AI agents acting on behalf of users and services. We also own transaction token management, issuing, propagating, and validating the tokens that carry identity and authorization context across multi-hop request chains. Together, these capabilities let Amazon's services trust who is calling them, what those callers are permitted to do, and on whose behalf they act — protecting customer data and maintaining the integrity of every transaction across the fleet.
  
  
We are looking for a Software Development Engineer II to design, build, and operate components of our authentication SDKs and supporting services. You will own features end-to-end: design through production operations across Java, Python, NodeJS, and Rust client libraries. You will collaborate with security teams, service owners, and business teams to close authentication gaps at scale.
  
  
This role suits an engineer who wants to own ambiguous, high-impact problems in a domain where correctness and availability are non-negotiable.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design and deliver features across Security SDKs, owning them from design document through production launch.
* Improve the static stability of authentication — ensure services continue operating through service outages via persistent caching, eager token refresh, and bounce-safe recovery.
* Build and maintain telemetry and compliance mechanisms that measure token propagation and detect gaps across the fleet.
* Diagnose and resolve production issues as part of the on-call rotation, and drive root-cause analysis and corrections for operational events.
* Own pipeline and release health for SDK components — keep pipelines fresh, unblock releases, and reduce time-to-deploy.
* Write clear design documents and participate in Operational Readiness Reviews (ORRs) and security reviews.
* Mentor SDE1s and interns; raise the technical bar through code reviews and design feedback.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 3+ years of Video Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops) experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance.

* Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

May include research, new development, prototyping, modification, reuse, re-engineering, maintenance, or any other activities related to software products used internally or externally on product platforms supported by the firm.
