As an engineer you will be responsible for enhancing and maintaining the key components of the Software stack, Platform enablement and an opportunity to work on closed and Open source development communities.
  
  
AI Software Engineer: As a Software Engineer with IBM AI on Z Solutions teams, you will get the opportunity to get involved in delivering best-in class Enterprise AI Solutions on IBM Z and support IBM Customers while adopting AI technologies / Solutions into their businesses by building ethical, secure, trustworthy and sustainable AI solutions on IBM Z.You will be part of end to end solutions working along with technically accomplished teams. You will be working as a Full stack developer starting from understanding client challenges to providing solutions using AI.
  
  
**IBM Spectrum Fusion SW Engineer:**
IBM Spectrum Fusion container-native storage solution for OpenShift is designed for enterprise customers who need global hybrid cloud data access. As a Software Engineer with IBM Storage Spectrum Fusion team, you will work with the Dev/Test team to develop and support features for Spectrum Fusion product roadmap.
  
  
**Linux Developer:**
As a Linux developer, you would be involved in design and development of advanced features in the Linux OS for the next generation server platforms from IBM by collaboration with the Linux community. You collaborate with teams across the hardware, firmware, and upstream Linux kernel community to deliver these capabilities.
  
  
**Hardware Management Console (HMC) / Novalink Software Developer:**

You will be involved in user centric Graphical User Interface development and Backend for server and virtualization management solution development in Agile environment.

AIX is a proprietary Unix operating system which runs on IBM Power Servers. It's a secure, scalable, and robust open standards-based UNIX operating system which is designed to meet the needs of Enterprises class infrastructure. As an AIX developer, you would be involved in development, test or support of AIX OS features development or open source software porting/development for AIX OS

As a performance Engineer , you will get an opportunity to conduct experiments and analysis to identify performance aspects for operating systems and Enterprise Servers. where you will be responsible for advancing the product roadmap by using your expertise in Linux operating system, building kernel , applying patches, performance characterization, optimization and hardware architecture to analyse performance of software/hardware combinations. You will be involved in conducting experiments and analysis to identify performance challenges and uncover optimization opportunities for IBM Power virtualization and cloud management software built on Open stack. ISDL works on end-to-end design, development across Power, Z and Storage portfolio. You would be a part of WW Firmware development organization and would be involved in designing & developing cutting edge features on the open source OpenBMC stack ([1] [1] [1] [1] [1] [1] https://github.com/openbmc/) and developing the open source embedded firmware code for bringing up the next generation enterprise Power, Z and LinuxONE Servers. The Enterprise Systems Design team is keen on hiring passionate Computer science and engineering graduates / Masters students, who can blend their architectural knowledge and programming skills to build the complex infrastructure geared to work for the Hybrid cloud and AI workloads. We have several opportunities in following areas of System & chip development team :

Will be responsible to creatively think of all the scenarios to test and report the coverage. Work with design as well as other key stakeholders in identifying /debugging & Resolving logic design issues and deliver a quality design

EDA tools development team is responsible for developing state of the art Front End verification , simulation , Formal verification tools , Place & Route, synthesis tools and Flows critical for designing & verifying high performance hardware design for IBM's next generation Systems (IBM P and Z Systems) which is used in Cognitive, ML, DL, and Data Center applications.

title: Architect – AI-Powered Performance Verification Automation
description:
NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself. Our invention of the GPU sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. Today, research in artificial intelligence is booming worldwide, which calls for highly scalable and massively parallel computation horsepower that NVIDIA GPUs excel.
  
  
NVIDIA is a “learning machine” that constantly evolves by adapting to new opportunities that are hard to solve, that only we can address, and that matter to the world. This is our life’s work , to amplify human creativity and intelligence. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join our diverse team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world. As part of this team, you would be working on projects that will help make our next generation visual computing, automotive, GPU, HPC systems better. You will get to work on high performance CPU and Memory sub-systems, Next-Gen GPUs , NOC based Interconnect Fabric etc. Make the choice to join us today.
  
  
We are looking for a motivated engineer to drive the transformation of performance verification workflows through AI and automation. In this role, you will design, develop, and deploy solutions that accelerate verification cycles, improve coverage, and reduce manual effort across hardware performance verification project lifecycles. You will be at the forefront of redefining how performance verification is done at scale — replacing repetitive manual analysis with intelligent, self-improving automation that helps engineers focus on what matters most.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Automate verification workflows by building AI/ML-based tools that generate, triage, and analyse performance test cases and results
* Develop intelligent agents that can identify performance regressions, root-cause failures, and recommend corrective actions
* Integrate LLM-based assistants into existing verification infrastructure to enable natural-language querying of results, specs, and coverage data
* Design data pipelines to collect, curate, and label verification data for model training and continuous improvement
* Collaborate with verification engineers to understand pain points, define automation priorities, and validate AI-driven solutions against real-world workflows
* Establish metrics and dashboards to measure automation impact (cycle time reduction, coverage improvement, engineer productivity)
* Stay current with state-of-the-art techniques in generative AI, reinforcement learning, and formal methods as they apply to hardware verification

**What We Need To See**

* B.Tech/M.Tech/PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
* 3+ years of experience in hardware verification, performance validation, or EDA tool development
* Strong programming skills in Python; familiarity with C/C++, SystemVerilog/UVM is a plus
* Hands-on experience with ML/AI frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn) or LLM APIs (OpenAI, NVIDIA NIM/NeMo)
* Understanding of performance verification methodologies (benchmarking, profiling, regression analysis)
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Experience applying ML to EDA or verification problems (e.g., coverage closure, bug prediction, test generation)
* Familiarity with RAG architectures, prompt engineering, and agentic AI frameworks (LangChain, CrewAI, etc.)
* Knowledge of NVIDIA GPU/SoC architecture or similar complex hardware platforms
* Published work or patents in AI-for-verification or related domains

Shape the Future of Aerospace. Engineer What’s Next.
  
  
At
**RTX**
, the world’s largest aerospace and defense company, approximately 185,000 innovators come together with a shared purpose: solving the world’s most complex challenges and making a meaningful difference. Through our industry-leading businesses, advanced research, and cutting-edge technologies, we are redefining what’s possible in aerospace and defense.
  
  
**Collins Aerospace**
, an RTX business, is at the forefront of developing intelligent, technologically advanced solutions that connect and protect our world. Our innovations help shape the future of flight, enhance aircraft capabilities, and enable safer, smarter, and more connected aviation systems.
  
  
Are you ready to work on software that powers the future of airborne communication?
  
  
We are looking for an experienced
**Principal Engineer – Avionics Communication & Data Link Systems**
to join our Airborne Information Solutions Department within the Communication, Navigation, and Surveillance (CNS) division. As part of the End-to-End Communication Team, you will contribute to the development, verification, integration, and certification of advanced avionics communication applications that support reliable, safety-critical airborne connectivity.
  
  
This is an opportunity to apply your software engineering expertise to complex aerospace challenges, work with industry-leading avionics standards, and help deliver mission-critical technologies that keep aircraft and the global aviation ecosystem connected.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  
As part of our avionics software engineering team, you will:
  
  

* Design and develop advanced avionics software: Contribute to the architecture, development, integration, and verification of airborne communication applications using C, C++, and Python.
* Engineer next-generation data link solutions: Develop and verify applications supporting Controller-Pilot Data Link Communications (CPDLC), Automatic Dependent Surveillance–Contract (ADS-C), ATN Context Management (CM), and FANS ACARS Facilities Notification (AFN).
* Apply industry-leading aviation standards: Implement and maintain compliance with relevant ARINC standards, including ARINC 429, 618, 620, 622, 661, 739, and 615.
* Deliver certification-ready software: Apply DO-178B/C processes and contribute to the development of high-integrity, safety-critical software that meets stringent aviation certification objectives.
* Drive software quality and verification: Perform requirements analysis, verification and validation (V&V), structural coverage analysis (SCA), debugging, troubleshooting, and unit, integration, white-box, and verification testing.
* Enable seamless system integration: Support software-software and hardware-software integration, identify complex system-level issues, and drive effective technical resolutions.
* Support certification and compliance activities: Prepare for and participate in Stages of Involvement (SOI), certification reviews, technical audits, and engagements with internal and external compliance authorities.
* Collaborate across engineering disciplines: Work closely with systems, software, integration, verification, and certification teams to deliver robust, reliable, and high-quality solutions.
* Strengthen engineering excellence: Contribute to requirements management, reliability analysis, risk mitigation, process optimization, and continuous improvement across the software development lifecycle.
* Leverage advanced engineering tools: Use network analyzers, simulation environments, and software development and verification tools to validate performance and troubleshoot complex avionics systems.

What You’ll Bring
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering (B.Tech/M.Tech), with a foundation in avionics systems and software architecture.
* 12+ years of avionics software development and verification experience.
* Strong programming proficiency in C or C++ and Python.
* Solid understanding of avionics systems and architectures, including Data Link, Communication, Navigation and Surveillance (CNS), Flight Management Systems (FMS), Flight Control Systems (FCS), and aircraft displays.
* Strong understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), covering requirements analysis, software design, coding, integration, verification, and validation.
* Practical exposure to DO-178B/C processes and safety-critical software development.
* Hands-on experience with V&V, structural coverage analysis, debugging, troubleshooting, and white-box, unit, integration, and verification testing.
* Experience with software development and verification tools such as VectorCAST, PyATE, RapiTest, Git, and Subversion.
* Familiarity with real-time operating systems and network analyzer tools used for communication and performance testing.
* Understanding of Agile methodologies and experience working in an Agile engineering environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience developing, integrating, and certifying large-scale avionics software systems.
* Strong knowledge of safety-critical software architecture, design principles, and development practices.
* Practical experience with airborne communication and data link protocols, including applicable ARINC standards.
* Familiarity with avionics simulation environments and system-level testing.
* Experience supporting formal certification reviews, SOI activities, compliance audits, and certification evidence preparation.
* Ability to analyze complex technical problems, collaborate across engineering disciplines, and drive issues through to resolution.

What You’ll Gain
  
  
At Collins Aerospace, your work contributes to technologies that have a direct impact on the future of aviation.
  
  

* Meaningful engineering challenges: Work on advanced avionics communication applications that support aircraft connectivity and operational safety.
* Technical depth and innovation: Apply your expertise in embedded software, data link protocols, real-time systems, and safety-critical engineering.
* End-to-end product exposure: Participate across the software lifecycle, from requirements and design through verification, integration, and certification.
* Collaborative engineering: Partner with experienced professionals across software, systems, integration, and certification disciplines.
* Continuous improvement: Contribute ideas that strengthen engineering processes, software quality, and technical excellence.

**Why Join Collins Aerospace?**
Collins Aerospace, a
**Raytheon Technologies company**
, is a global leader in advanced aerospace and defense solutions. Our Avionics business delivers trusted navigation, communication, surveillance, and safety systems used worldwide.
  
  
At Collins Aerospace, you will:
  
  

* Work alongside industry-leading experts
* Build technologies that protect lives and enable safer aviation
* Grow your career while shaping the future of aerospace innovation

We are redefining aerospace—and you can be part of it.

Collaboration and innovation are core to our culture, supported by world-class digital tools and global connectivity.

**Role Overview**
Analog Devices International is seeking an experienced Staff Design Evaluation Engineer to join the Automotive Networking team in Hyderabad, India. In this senior technical role, you will lead the definition and execution of evaluation strategies for FPGA prototypes and automotive networking ASICs, from initial platform bring-up through system-level validation, characterisation, and release readiness. You will combine hands-on laboratory expertise with strong software development, test automation, data analysis, and technical leadership skills to deliver robust, repeatable, and high-quality evaluation solutions.
  
  
You will work closely with design, verification, applications, systems, software, and product engineering teams to identify technical risks, resolve complex issues, and ensure that silicon and supporting platforms meet product and system requirements. As a Staff Engineer, you will provide technical direction, mentor engineers, and drive improvements in evaluation methodologies, tools, and laboratory practices.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and lead comprehensive evaluation strategies, test plans, coverage goals, methodologies, and release criteria for FPGA prototypes and automotive networking ASICs.
* Translate product, architecture, and system requirements into measurable laboratory tests, including functional, performance, interoperability, robustness, and corner-case evaluation.
* Architect, develop, bring up, and maintain hardware and software evaluation platforms, test fixtures, reference systems, and supporting infrastructure.
* Develop modular, maintainable test and automation software in C and Python, including instrument control, data acquisition, regression execution, result processing, and report generation.
* Execute and analyse complex silicon and FPGA test cases; debug failures across hardware, firmware, software, interfaces, and system boundaries.
* Perform electrical and functional measurements using oscilloscopes, logic analysers, protocol analysers, signal generators, power supplies, and other laboratory equipment.
* Lead structured root-cause investigations, clearly document findings, and work with cross-functional teams to drive issues to resolution.
* Evaluate Automotive Ethernet T1S and related networking functionality, including link behaviour, data-path performance, timing, error handling, diagnostics, and interoperability.
* Develop system-level hardware, embedded software, scripts, user guides, application examples, test procedures, and technical reports that enable internal and external product evaluation.
* Review evaluation results, identify coverage gaps and technical risks, and communicate evidence-based recommendations to engineering and programme stakeholders.
* Drive continuous improvement in test architecture, automation, data quality, traceability, repeatability, and laboratory efficiency.
* Provide technical leadership and mentoring, lead design and code reviews, and contribute to planning, estimation, and prioritisation activities.

**Required Qualifications And Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Typically seven or more years of relevant experience in design evaluation, silicon validation, product engineering, systems engineering, or a comparable role.
* Demonstrated experience evaluating FPGA prototypes and performing bench validation or characterisation of ASICs.
* Strong proficiency in C and Python, with experience developing reliable test, automation, or embedded software.
* Strong knowledge of embedded systems, digital hardware, laboratory measurement techniques, and hardware/software integration.
* Proven ability to diagnose complex problems using structured debugging, critical thinking, root-cause analysis, and evidence-based decision-making.
* Experience capturing, processing, interpreting, and presenting technical data, with a strong focus on accuracy, repeatability, and traceability.
* Working knowledge of Ethernet and networking concepts, together with experience using serial interfaces such as SPI, I²C, and UART.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear technical reports and present complex findings to varied audiences.
* Demonstrated technical leadership, collaboration, ownership, and the ability to influence outcomes across cross-functional teams.

**Preferred Qualifications And Experience**

* Experience with automotive Ethernet technologies, including 10BASE-T1S, single-pair Ethernet, MAC-PHY devices, Physical Layer Collision Avoidance, or related in-vehicle networking solutions.
* Familiarity with automotive networking architectures, zonal systems, software-defined vehicles, and relevant industry standards.
* Experience with Ethernet protocol analysis, network traffic generation, performance measurement, interoperability testing, or fault injection.
* Experience developing embedded firmware for microcontrollers and integrating host-side software with evaluation hardware.
* Experience with audio and video interfaces or data paths, including PDM and RGB8.
* Familiarity with source control, continuous integration, automated regression frameworks, requirements traceability, and issue-tracking systems.
* Experience mentoring engineers, leading technical reviews, or coordinating evaluation activities across multiple sites or disciplines.

*For positions requiring access to technical data, Analog Devices, Inc. may have to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce - Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U.S. Department of State - Directorate of Defense Trade Controls. title: Senior Software Development Engineer L4
description:
**Who We Are**
Inovalon was founded in 1998 on the belief that technology, and data specifically, would empower the transformation of the entire healthcare ecosystem for the better, improving both outcomes and economics. At Inovalon, we believe that when our customers are successful in their missions, healthcare improves. Therefore, we focus on empowering them with data-driven solutions. And the momentum is building.
  
  
Together, as ONE Inovalon, we are a united force delivering solutions that address healthcare’s greatest needs. Through our mission-based culture of inclusion and innovation, our organization brings value not just to our customers, but to the millions of patients and members they serve.
  
  
**Who You Are**
As a Performance Automation Engineer, you help ensure our applications are scalable, reliable, and responsive under a wide range of user and system demands. You work closely with development, QA, and DevOps teams to evaluate system behavior, identify performance risks, and drive measurable improvements. You bring a strong foundation in performance testing and engineering, and you use data, observability, and collaboration to improve readiness for production. In this role, your work directly supports resilient systems and better outcomes for internal teams and clients.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Design, develop, and maintain performance test scripts using JMeter to validate application scalability, reliability, and responsiveness.
* Execute load, stress, spike, and endurance tests to simulate real-world traffic patterns and assess production readiness.
* Analyze application behavior under load and identify performance bottlenecks across CPU, memory, database, network, and related system components.
* Partner with development, QA, and DevOps teams to troubleshoot issues, optimize application performance, and support performance tuning efforts.
* Integrate performance tests into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous validation and early detection of performance regressions.
* Monitor application and infrastructure performance using tools such as Datadog and correlate metrics, logs, and traces to support root cause analysis.
* Prepare detailed performance reports that summarize observations, trends, risks, and recommendations for stakeholders.
* Support capacity planning activities by evaluating system limits, usage patterns, and projected performance needs.

**What You'll Need**

* 4 to 7 years of experience in performance testing and performance engineering.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Information Technology, or equivalent combination of education and experience required.
* Strong hands-on experience with JMeter for performance and load testing.
* Solid understanding of performance testing concepts, including load, stress, spike, and endurance testing.
* Experience analyzing test results and identifying performance bottlenecks.
* Familiarity with web technologies, including HTTP/HTTPS and REST APIs.
* Ability to correlate application performance with infrastructure metrics.
* Hands-on experience with monitoring tools such as Datadog.
* Ability to analyze logs, metrics, and traces for root cause analysis.
* Understanding of Application Performance Monitoring concepts.
* Basic knowledge of Linux/Unix systems.
* Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins and Azure DevOps.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the ability to break down performance issues and use evidence to guide decisions.
* Good communication and stakeholder management skills in a fast-paced, agile environment.
* Demonstrate growth potential and learning agility by quickly building knowledge in new tools, systems, and performance engineering practices as needs evolve.
* Demonstrate leadership by collaborating effectively with cross-functional partners, influencing performance-focused decisions, and working through differing perspectives constructively.
* Demonstrate adaptability by adjusting priorities and approach in response to changing project needs, system conditions, and business timelines.
* Demonstrate creative thinking by identifying practical, innovative ways to improve test coverage, performance visibility, and system efficiency.
* Demonstrate analytical skills by interpreting test data, identifying patterns, and drawing sound conclusions to support performance improvements.
* Nice to have: Experience with modern performance tools such as K6 or Gatling; knowledge of scripting languages such as JavaScript, Groovy, or similar; experience with distributed load testing; understanding of cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.

**Our Shared Commitments**

* Maintain compliance with Inovalon’s policies, procedures and mission statement;
* Adhere to all confidentiality and HIPAA requirements as outlined within Inovalon’s Operating Policies and Procedures in all ways and at all times with respect to any aspect of the data handled or services rendered in the undertaking of the position; and
* Fulfill those responsibilities and/or duties that may be reasonably provided by Inovalon for the purpose of achieving operational and financial success of Employer.

**Work Environment**

* This is primarily a computer-based role performed in a remote, hybrid, or office environment. The role requires prolonged periods of computer use and frequent communication and interaction with others, either virtually and/or in person. The role may occasionally require transporting or moving work-related equipment weighing up to 10 pounds, such as a laptop and related materials. Some travel may be required, depending on the needs of the role. Reasonable accommodations may be provided to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position, consistent with applicable law.

*This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship (e.g. H-1B, TN, or E-3). Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States as a condition of employment. (This is only applicable for US-based positions)*
*If you don’t meet every qualification listed but are excited about our mission and the work described, we encourage you to apply. Inovalon is most interested in finding the best candidate for the job, and you may be just the right person for this or other roles.*
*By embracing inclusion, we enhance our work environment and drive business success. Inovalon strives to provide equal opportunities to the communities where we operate and to our clients and everyone whom we serve. We endeavor to create a culture of inclusion in which our associates feel empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work and pursue their professional goals in an equitable setting. We understand that by fostering this type of culture, and welcoming different perspectives, we generate innovation and growth.*
*Inovalon is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirement.*

*link*
*To review the California Consumer Privacy Statement: Disclosures for California Residents, please visit this*
*link*
*Work Location: If the US position is listed as remote, employees who reside within a 40-mile radius of one of our office locations in Tampa, FL; Canonsburg, PA; or Bowie, MD will follow a hybrid work schedule and are expected to work in the office two days per week (Tuesdays and Wednesdays).*

title: JD-SDET-Test-Automation
description: Role Overview We are looking for a hands-on Software Development Engineer in Test who is technically strong in Selenium with Java, REST Assured, and Postman, and very strong across UI testing, API testing, and database testing. These skills are the foundation of this role and you will use them every day to build automation frameworks, validate services and data end to end, and keep our regression suites stable and trustworthy. Depth in these areas is essential. This is not a role where they can be picked up on the job. You are a strong software engineer first and a tester second. You will design and own Selenium WebDriver frameworks in Java, automate REST and SOAP APIs with REST Assured and Postman, and validate data directly in relational databases using SQL. You will work closely with developers, business analysts, product owners, and client teams, so clear communication and genuine collaboration matter as much as technical depth. You will own work across the full quality lifecycle: test strategy, framework design, functional and regression automation, API and database testing, CI/CD integration, test data management, defect triage, and production quality monitoring. This is a coding role, not a manual testing or test management-only role.Key Responsibilities UI Testing Design, build, and maintain scalable UI automation frameworks using Selenium WebDriver with Java, applying the Page Object Model, TestNG or JUnit, data-driven design, and reusable utilities. Build and maintain Playwright test suites for web, cross-browser, and end-to-end regression coverage, using fixtures, auto-waiting, and parallel execution, and support teams whose products are automated in Playwright. Write stable UI tests in both Selenium and Playwright with resilient locator strategies, proper waits and synchronization, parallel execution on Selenium Grid and Playwright workers, and clear failure evidence such as screenshots, logs, and traces. API Testing Build and maintain API automation for REST services using REST Assured with Java, covering positive, negative, and boundary scenarios, authentication and authorization, request chaining, and JSON schema validation. Use Postman for exploratory API testing, collection design, environment and variable management, and automated collection runs with Newman in CI, and test SOAP services where required. Validate status codes, headers, payloads, and error handling, and confirm that API responses match the data stored in the database. Database Testing Write and run SQL to validate data integrity, constraints, referential integrity, stored procedures, triggers, and views across relational databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, or PostgreSQL. Validate data migrations, ETL jobs, and batch processes by reconciling source and target data, and build automated backend data checks into the regression suites. Create and manage test data through SQL scripts and APIs, including setup, teardown, and masking of sensitive data. Engineering and Quality Ownership Integrate UI, API, and database test suites into CI/CD pipelines with parallel execution and consolidated reporting. Define the test strategy for new features, covering risk analysis, coverage targets, test data strategy, and entry and exit criteria. Perform code reviews for both application code and test code, and advocate for testability in design and architecture discussions. Investigate failures, trace each defect to the layer where it originates (UI, API, or database), and drive it to closure with clear, reproducible reporting and evidence. Track and publish quality metrics such as automation coverage, flakiness, escaped defects, and mean time to detection, and act on the trends. Collaboration and Communication Work closely with developers, business analysts, product owners, and client stakeholders in Agile ceremonies to clarify requirements, raise risks early, and agree on acceptance criteria. Communicate test progress, quality risks, and release readiness clearly to both technical and business audiences. Share automation practices and coding standards with the wider QA team and mentor less experienced engineers. Required Qualifications These are essential. Candidates must be strong in all of the following to succeed in this role. 5+ years of professional experience in software testing, with at least 2 years in a hands-on SDET or test automation engineering role. Very strong Java programming skills, including object-oriented design, collections, and exception handling, with a track record of writing clean, maintainable, production-quality test code. Very strong hands-on experience with Selenium WebDriver and Java, including building frameworks from scratch with the Page Object Model, TestNG or JUnit, and Maven or Gradle, and handling waits, iframes, multiple windows, and dynamic elements. Very strong hands-on experience with REST Assured, including request and response specifications, authentication (OAuth, JWT, API keys), serialization and deserialization of payloads, and JSON schema validation. Very strong hands-on experience with Postman, including collections, environments and variables, pre-request and test scripts, and running collections with Newman. Deep understanding of API testing concepts: HTTP methods, status codes, headers, REST principles, contract validation, and testing of SOAP services. Very strong SQL and database testing skills, including joins, subqueries, aggregations, and window functions, and validating data integrity, stored procedures, and data migrations across Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, or PostgreSQL. Proven ability to validate end-to-end business flows across the UI, API, and database layers.Experience with CI/CD tooling such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps. Proficiency with Git, branching strategies, and code review practices, plus strong software engineering fundamentals. Strong collaboration skills, with experience working closely with developers, business analysts, product owners, and client teams in an Agile environment. Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain quality risk clearly to both engineers and business stakeholders. title: SDET – AI Tools & Test Automation
description: Anthrobyte wins by putting AI agents into the real operations of enterprise clients — and making them work, in production, where it matters. Production is only trusted when it has been proven. We need an engineer who can prove it: someone who tests AI systems the way they actually behave, not the way a demo suggests, and who builds the tooling that lets the whole team do the same. This is a build-from-the-front role. You test inside the problem, against the client’s real data and constraints, not from a checklist. What you’ll own Quality for AI in production. You decide what “good enough to ship” means for systems that don’t behave the same way twice. Evaluation sets, regression suites, hallucination and guardrail checks — you design them, run them, and defend the results. Performance and benchmarking. You build repeatable benchmarks for latency, throughput, and retrieval quality across pipelines, vector search, and agent workflows — and you explain why the numbers moved. Quality gates in the pipeline. You embed automated tests into CI/CD so nothing reaches a client’s live operations without passing them. The gate is yours, and so is the call when it should stay shut. The product loop. You turn what you learn in the field into reusable test frameworks, benchmarks, and standards inside AATLAS — so every engagement makes the next one faster and safer, and we compound into a product, not a services treadmill. Raising the standard. This is the multiplier. You mentor engineers in test automation and performance practice, and codify how we test into a playbook others can run without you. Success is a team that tests the way you do, not you testing everything. Client trust. You present benchmark and quality findings to engineering leads, client security, and business stakeholders — in architecture reviews, security reviews, and the room where decisions get made — and you hold your position when the answer is “not ready yet.” RequirementsWhat we’re looking for Production track record. 7–10 years in software testing, at least 5 of them as an SDET or automation engineer. You’ve built test frameworks from scratch and lived with what you shipped. Core automation, with depth. Expert in Python and Pytest — framework design, fixtures, parametrization, reporting — and in Postman, with API suites automated in CI. Production experience in at least one UI framework: Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium. Performance engineering. Hands-on with Locust, Gatling, k6, or JMeter, and able to interpret results rather than just generate them. Delivery plumbing. CI/CD in GitLab, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps. Docker. At least one cloud platform (AWS or Azure). Backend and database testing. Range. You’re equally comfortable writing code, designing a test strategy, and explaining a failure to a non-technical stakeholder. Systems mindset. You think in reliability, not test counts. Enterprise AI is won on auditability and things that keep working.Bonus points Experience testing ML and LLM systems, RAG pipelines, vector databases, embeddings, or MCP-based agent workflows. Familiarity with LLM evaluation approaches and tooling. A second UI framework, Jest, or BDD tooling (SpecFlow, pytest-bdd, behave). Accessibility and security testing (axe, OWASP ZAP). Experience in regulated or enterprise environments such as finance, healthcare, or telecom. A track record of growing junior engineers into independent operators. What this role is not A manual tester working from scripts. A pure automation engineer who runs suites someone else designed. A researcher who benchmarks in isolation and never sees a client’s reality. If you want to test from a distance rather than from inside the problem, this isn’t it. How we work Small, high-trust, founder-close team. Governance-first, because our work runs inside clients’ live operations. You’ll have real authority over what “ready” means, and the mandate to build the testing capability we’ll become known for. How to apply Tell us two stories. First: a system you tested or benchmarked where the numbers surprised you, what you built to find out, and what you did when the answer was uncomfortable.Second: a release you heldback, or a standard you set, that others pushed against, and how it played out. Those two stories tell us more than any CV.

description:

**Position Summary**
 Cyber
   

  

 Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever\-changing threat landscape.  Position Summary
   

  

 Level: Senior Solution Advisor
   

  

 Work you’ll do:
   

  

 As a Senior Consultant, you are responsible for performing following activities as a SAST/DAST professional:
   

  

* Integrate SAST and DAST tools into CI/CD pipelines to automate security testing throughout the development lifecycle.
* Perform regular static (SAST) and dynamic (DAST) security assessments on applications to identify vulnerabilities such as SQL injection, cross\-site scripting, and other OWASP Top 10 risks.
* Analyze scan results, triage findings, and provide actionable remediation guidance to development teams.
* Collaborate with developers to ensure secure coding practices and support secure design reviews.
* Define and maintain security roles, responsibilities, and ownership between Deloitte and client stakeholders for test preparation, execution, and support.
* Ensure that vulnerabilities are tracked, reported, and resolved in accordance with organizational policies and client requirements.
* Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) workshops and publish performance and security testing reports.
* Stay current with industry trends, emerging threats, and advancements in SAST/DAST tools and methodologies.


 The Team:
   

  

 Enterprise Security teams embed cybersecurity across all facets of digital transformation by securing a client’s technical infrastructure, while enabling innovation and agility. Their services span security architecture, secure development, cloud cyber capabilities, application and emerging technology security, and secure\-by\-design initiatives. DevSecOps further integrates automated security into the software development lifecycle, embedding testing and remediation within CI/CD pipelines for agile, risk\-aware deployment. Through Deloitte’s DevSecOps framework, teams drive operational efficiency and secure design principles, ensuring robust protection in cloud and application environments.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:
   

  

* 7\-9 years of h ands\-on experience with leading SAST and DAST tools (e.g., Checkmarx , Veracode, Fortify, Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP).
* Strong understanding of secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC) principles and OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities.
* Experience integrating security testing into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI).
* Ability to interpret and communicate vulnerability findings and remediation steps to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Familiarity with both black\-box (DAST) and white\-box (SAST) testing methodologies.
* Excellent collaboration, communication, and documentation skills.
* Excellent collaboration, communication, and documentation skills.


 Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:
   

  

* Experience participating in or conducting security architecture reviews to identify design\-level vulnerabilities and ensure alignment with security best practices and organizational standards.

* Skill in translating threat model findings into actionable SAST/DAST test cases and ensuring that identified threats are adequately tested and mitigated.
* Security certifications such as CSSLP, CEH, or similar.
* Experience with cloud\-native application security and container security.
* Knowledge of regulatory and compliance requirements related to application security.


 Education:
   

  

* Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, or equivalent experience.

title: Senior Firmware Engineer
description:
**Overview**
 Microsoft Silicon, Cloud Hardware, and Infrastructure Engineering (SCHIE) is the team behind Microsoft’s expanding Cloud Infrastructure and responsible for powering Microsoft’s “Intelligent Cloud” mission. SCHIE delivers the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's over 200 online businesses including Bing, MSN, Office 365, Xbox Live, Teams, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform globally with our server and data center infrastructure, security and compliance, operations, globalization, and manageability solutions. Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and delivering a trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide and we are looking for passionate engineers to help achieve that mission.
   

  

 Are you passionate about working on cutting edge new technology in a team that embodies the growth mindset? Are you hoping to join an organization which is built on a mission “To empower every person and organization on this planet to achieve more”?
   

  

 We are working on the next generation Hardware/Firmware for server, silicon, and rack infrastructure of Cobalt/Maia systems with a focus on innovation in firmware technology to secure Azure infrastructure for Microsoft and their customers.
   

  

 We are looking for a highly motivated Senior Engineer who is passionate about system level thinking, deep debugging, and scalable validation, and who thrives in a cross\-functional, fast paced environment spanning silicon, firmware, GPU, OS, and manufacturing.
   

  

 \#SCHIE
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 As a Senior Firmware Engineer in the Firmware System Engineering team, you will own platform‑level firmware integration and validation across SoC firmware, GPU, BIOS, BMC, and OS interactions. You will contribute directly to early silicon bring‑up, de‑risking of firmware releases, customer issue debug, and continuous improvement of validation strategies, tooling, and automation—building on the foundations already established by the team.
   

  

* You will be involved with all phases of product development including pre\-silicon, post\-silicon, and platform deployment in the datacenter.
* You will collaborate with platform architects, firmware architects, program management and component dev teams for understanding the technical depth of the new features and defining the Test plans/cases, validation Frameworks/Tools/methodology for End\-to\-end feature readiness
* You will define the Soc and platform validation methodology in terms of required test cases, faster debugging/triaging, reducing manual efforts, with enhanced coverage of concurrent/deployment scenarios
* You will be involved in debugging and solving complex hardware/firmware interface issues.
* You will own coordination, Integration, validation (including validation environment), and debugging of system software comprising of different domains within server architecture (such as SoC FWs, BIOS, BMC etc.)
* You will architect and/or submit requirements to define stimulus, test content, and frameworks that will be utilized to conduct testing and establish coverage.
* You will identify and address inefficiencies and gaps in architecture, testing, execution, etc.
* You will mentor, guide, and help peers and other team members.
* Ability to see system level “big picture” to validate that the integrated firmware/system software aligns to architectural goals of product.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or similar.
* 8\+ years of working experience in large scale system design \& architecture, development, testing, and release and performance tuning.
* Strong problem solving, debugging, and troubleshooting skills.
* Hands on experience in programming in Python or C or C\+\+
* Experience with Platform initialization, Board support package (UEFI/U\-Boot), integration, low level drivers for peripherals such as PCIe, I2C, eMMC, SPI, USB, UARTs as well as Memory Management, Scheduling, Interrupts, and multi\-threading.
* Excellent debugging and troubleshooting skills with the aim to become point\-of\-contact for platform level issues. Ensure systematic closure of issues for subsequent releases.
* Demonstrated experience of leading big initiatives spanning multiple teams and organizations and leveraging deep domain expertise to influence product roadmap.
* Passionate about exploring and deploying noble methods to improve coverage, debugging, and efficiency of our FW releases.

These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.
   

  

 This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

 Join our DTCC family, and you’ll grow your expertise and become the best version of you. As you embark on a new journey, you’ll seek challenges with flexibility and patience, learning new skills and advancing your career while having the time of your life.

 You will be part of the Enterprise Product \& Platform Engineering (EPPE) organization, responsible for providing centralized, independent infrastructure testing and quality assurance services. This role focuses on driving infrastructure testing delivery, governance, and coordination across projects, ensuring improved system stability, compliance, and release readiness.
   

  

 The Lead Business Systems Analyst will act as a delivery lead/project coordinator for infrastructure testing, managing backlog execution, prioritization, stakeholder communication, and reporting.

 Infrastructure Testing Delivery \& Coordination
   

  

* Lead end\-to\-end infrastructure testing delivery across multiple concurrent programs and releases
* Coordinate testing activities aligned with application and infrastructure release plans
* Act as the primary liaison between Infrastructure Engineering, Application Teams, and Test teams
* Ensure test readiness across environments (build validation, baseline validation, integration readiness)
* Track and manage dependencies, risks, and testing milestones


 Agile Delivery \& Work Management

* Manage and monitor story progress, defect tracking, and test execution status

* Optimize workflow efficiency and reduce delivery bottlenecks

* Monitor utilization across onshore/offshore teams
* Balance competing priorities across multiple initiatives
* Identify capacity gaps and escalate proactively

* Provide insights on: \- Test coverage
* Automation progress
* Defects and quality trends
* Delivery risks and timelines

* Identify process gaps and drive improvements through automation and standardization

* Hands\-on experience with JIRA (backlog, workflows, reporting)
* Experience working in infrastructure or platform environments (cloud/on\-prem)
* Strong understanding of risk, compliance, and audit expectations
* Proactively identifies and mitigates delivery risks
* Good understanding of the role of automation in various SDLCs (e.g. agile, scrum, waterfall) and mentor, train and coach resources.
* Ability to work on multiple work streams concurrently in a fast\-paced environment with extreme multi\-tasking and context switching.

title: QA Lead (Copado Robotic testing)
description:
**What You Will Do**
 Let’s do this. Let’s change the world.
 **Amgen is seeking a QA Lead – Salesforce \& Copado Robotic Testing** 
 to lead quality engineering and testing capabilities for enterprise Salesforce platforms, including OneCRM and its integrated ecosystem. This role will be responsible for ensuring high\-quality, reliable, and compliant application releases through a combination of
 **manual, functional, integration, regression, and automated testing using Copado Robotic Testing (CRT)** 
 .
   

  

 The QA Lead will own the end\-to\-end testing strategy and execution, lead cross\-functional QA teams, and partner closely with business, product, engineering, architecture, and production support teams to ensure releases meet functional, technical, and quality expectations while supporting Amgen’s mission to serve patients.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**QA \& Testing Leadership**
* Lead end\-to\-end QA activities for Salesforce applications and their integrated ecosystem, ensuring high\-quality releases with minimal production defects.
* Define and drive the overall test strategy, test planning, execution, defect management, and reporting across releases.
* Lead testing activities across functional, integration, system, regression, end\-to\-end, and user acceptance testing phases.
* Ensure appropriate test coverage based on business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, technical designs, and integration specifications.
* Serve as the primary QA point of contact for product, business, engineering, and technology stakeholders.


**Manual \& Functional Testing**
* Lead comprehensive manual testing of Salesforce applications, including business processes, workflows, validations, security, profiles, permission sets, and user experience.
* Design, review, and maintain test scenarios, test cases, test data, and expected results.
* Ensure adequate coverage of positive, negative, boundary, exception, and end\-to\-end business scenarios.
* Validate complex Salesforce business processes spanning multiple objects, personas, applications, and integrations.
* Drive exploratory and risk\-based testing for business\-critical capabilities.


**Copado Robotic Testing \& Test Automation**
* Lead adoption and implementation of Copado Robotic Testing (CRT) for Salesforce test automation.
* Design and maintain reusable, scalable, and maintainable automated test suites using Copado Robotic Testing.
* Identify appropriate manual regression scenarios for automation based on business criticality, repeatability, and ROI.
* Establish and continuously improve the automated regression test suite to increase coverage and reduce manual testing effort.
* Integrate automated testing into CI/CD and release pipelines wherever applicable.
* Monitor automation execution results, investigate failures, and ensure timely maintenance of automated test scripts.
* Define standards and best practices for Copado Robotic Testing development, execution, and maintenance.


**Integration \& End\-to\-End Testing**
* Lead end\-to\-end testing across Salesforce and integrated enterprise platforms, including MuleSoft APIs, Databricks, and other upstream/downstream applications.
* Validate API integrations, data transformations, interface processing, error handling, and data reconciliation.
* Coordinate testing dependencies across multiple application and technology teams.
* Ensure critical business journeys are validated across the complete application and integration landscape.


**Defect Management \& Quality Governance**
* Establish and enforce standardized defect management, triage, prioritization, and closure processes.
* Lead defect triage sessions with business, development, and product teams.
* Ensure defects are appropriately categorized based on severity, priority, business impact, and release risk.
* Track defect trends, leakage, reopen rates, and recurring quality issues.
* Drive root cause analysis for escaped production defects and implement preventive actions.
* Establish appropriate quality gates and release\-readiness criteria before production deployment.


**Test Planning \& Release Management**
* Develop comprehensive test plans and testing schedules aligned with sprint and release timelines.
* Estimate QA effort and determine appropriate testing capacity based on release scope and complexity.
* Coordinate QA activities across Agile sprints, major releases, hotfixes, patches, and production maintenance releases.
* Assess testing risks and proactively communicate potential impacts to release timelines.
* Provide clear QA sign\-off and release\-readiness recommendations based on test results, open defects, and residual risks.
* Support post\-production validation and hypercare testing following major releases.


**Quality Engineering \& Continuous Improvement**
* Drive the transition from traditional testing toward a quality engineering and automation\-first approach.
* Identify opportunities to reduce repetitive manual testing through automation.
* Improve test efficiency through reusable test assets, automation, standardized processes, and optimized test data management.
* Establish QA standards, templates, metrics, and best practices across the delivery organization.
* Leverage defect and production incident trends to continuously strengthen regression coverage.
* Promote shift\-left testing, enabling early QA involvement during requirements, refinement, and solution\-design activities.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Partner with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Architects, Developers, Scrum Masters, and Production Support teams throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Participate in requirements and user\-story refinement to ensure requirements and acceptance criteria are clear, testable, and complete.
* Collaborate with upstream and downstream application teams to coordinate integration and end\-to\-end testing.
* Act as the bridge between business and technology teams for quality\-related discussions.
* Communicate testing progress, risks, defects, dependencies, and release readiness to leadership and key stakeholders.


**Team Leadership**
* Lead and mentor onshore/offshore QA and test automation teams.
* Drive appropriate allocation of QA resources based on release priorities and workload.
* Provide technical and functional guidance to manual and automation testers.
* Establish standards for test documentation, traceability, automation, and defect management.
* Drive knowledge sharing, cross\-skilling, and capability development within the QA team.
* Mentor team members on Salesforce testing, Copado Robotic Testing, quality engineering, and testing best practices.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
* 9–13 years of overall experience in Quality Assurance, Software Testing, or Quality Engineering.
* Significant experience leading QA activities for large\-scale enterprise applications and complex releases.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Strong experience in Salesforce functional and manual testing.
* Hands\-on experience with Copado Robotic Testing (CRT) for Salesforce test automation.
* Strong understanding of the Salesforce platform, preferably including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and/or Health Cloud.
* Experience developing and maintaining automated regression test suites.
* Experience testing Salesforce integrations, MuleSoft APIs, REST/SOAP services, and data interfaces.
* Experience with enterprise data platforms such as Databricks is preferred.
* Experience with end\-to\-end, integration, regression, API, and data validation testing.
* Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies and CI/CD practices.
* Familiarity with Copado, Jira, ServiceNow, or similar enterprise delivery and ticketing platforms.
* Experience with test management and defect tracking tools.
* Strong understanding of test automation strategy, quality gates, and release\-readiness criteria.
* Experience working in regulated environments, preferably pharmaceutical, healthcare, or life sciences.
* Understanding of GxP, compliance, data privacy, and validation requirements is preferred.
* Proven experience managing distributed onshore/offshore QA teams.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and leadership skills.


**Soft Skills**
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Strong communication and interpersonal abilities with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.
* High attention to detail and a strong commitment to quality and customer experience.
* Ability to prioritize multiple testing activities and deliver effectively under tight release timelines.
* Strong ownership and accountability for application quality.
* Team\-oriented with a proactive and collaborative mindset.
* Ability and willingness to mentor QA engineers and promote testing and automation best practices.
* Ability to challenge requirements and solutions constructively from a quality and end\-user perspective.
* Adaptable to changing business priorities, project requirements, and evolving technology.


**What You Can Expect Of Us**
 As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for our teammates’ professional and personal growth and well\-being.
   

  

 Together, we live the Amgen values as we continue advancing science to serve patients.

description:

In this key role, you will be responsible for developing, debugging, and deploying high\-quality test solutions for next\-generation semiconductor devices. This is an exciting opportunity to join our engineering team and contribute to the advancement of test programs for cutting\-edge ICs. The position is well\-suited for software engineers with a strong electronics background or semiconductor test engineers experienced in ATE Test program development.

You will work closely with cross\-functional teams to design, develop, and implement scalable MES solutions supporting manufacturing processes.

title: Deputy Director - AI Solution and Platforms
description:
**Overview**
 The AI Solution Engineer is a delivery focused engineer who designs, builds, and operates production agentic AI applications, along with the platform services those applications run on. Working within the technical direction set by AI Solutions and Platforms leadership, the AI Solution Engineer translates solution architecture into production grade agents, retrieval pipelines, tool and system integrations, evaluation harnesses, and the guardrails and observability that keep those systems reliable once live.
   

  

 The AI Solution Engineer is a hands on practitioner who codes, integrates, tests, and iterates, owning feature level delivery across one or more solution or platform tracks while building a working understanding of the wider AI platform. The role works daily with modern AI engineering tooling, including agentic frameworks such as LangChain and LangGraph, the Model Context Protocol, and coding agents such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and Codex. This is a technical builder first, with a growing architect mindset
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Responsibilities**
* Solution Architecture and Delivery: Architect, build and deploy production agentic AI applications for R\&D, taking them from problem definition and prototype through to production use by scientists and engineers.
* Hands On Engineering: Write production Python and own the difficult parts, including retrieval quality, tool and function design, multi agent orchestration, context management, structured outputs, latency and unit cost. Set the technical bar through design and code review.
* Agentic Framework Selection: Build with LangChain, LangGraph, MCP and agent to agent patterns. Select the appropriate model across Anthropic Claude, Azure OpenAI and Google model families, and recognise when a deterministic or classical machine learning approach is the correct answer.
* Evaluation and Quality: Establish evaluation as a delivery gate, covering golden datasets built with R\&D subject matter experts, automated evaluations in CI, regression and grounded Ness testing, red teaming, and human review in the loop. Take solutions from prototype into production and remain accountable for them once live.
* Platform Ownership: Own the shared AI platform for R\&D, including retrieval and vector infrastructure, agent runtime, prompt and model registry, MCP server and connector layer, guardrails, tracing and observability, cost attribution and rate management. Define reference architectures and reusable patterns so that downstream teams ship in weeks rather than quarters.
* MLOps and LLMOps: Embed CI/CD for models, prompts and agents, infrastructure as code, environment promotion, versioning, monitoring, incident response, model deprecation and migration.
* Enterprise Integration: Integrate AI solutions with the R\&D and enterprise estate, including PLM, LIMS, specification and document management systems, SAP, the Azure data platform and the enterprise Lakehouse.
* Security and Governance: Own security, privacy and governance for these systems in partnership with Cyber, Legal, Privacy and Responsible AI, covering access control, secrets management, handling of confidential formulation and specification data, and auditability. Contribute to AI governance standards for R\&D.
* People Leadership: Lead, coach and grow a team of AI and platform engineers. Develop technical depth in the team and build AI literacy across the wider R\&D community.
* Stakeholder Partnership: Partner with R\&D scientists, category and platform leaders to convert ambiguous scientific problems into scoped, valuable products, and to decline those that will not work. Manage delivery partners and vendors. Communicate credibly with a food scientist and a cloud architect in the same conversation, and with senior leadership on portfolio, risk and value.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Data Science or a related quantitative field. Masters preferred.
* 10 to 14 years in software, data or machine learning engineering, including at least 2 to 3 years building and running LLM and generative AI solutions in production.
* 2 or more years leading engineers, formally or as a senior technical lead, with evidence of having developed people.
* Strong hands\-on Python. Code quality will be assessed during the interview process.
* Deep practical experience with agentic AI, covering tool calling, planning, memory, multi agent and agent to agent patterns, retrieval augmented generation, structured output, guardrails and evaluation.
* Production experience with LangChain and LangGraph, or an equivalent framework such as LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, Pydantic AI or custom orchestration, with a clear view of the tradeoffs.
* Daily working use of AI coding agents such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex or Cursor, including agent configuration and custom tooling rather than inline completion alone.
* Solid understanding of LLM fundamentals, including context windows, embeddings, tokenization, fine tuning versus adapters versus prompting, and failure modes such as hallucination and prompt injection.
* Cloud and platform engineering experience. Azure preferred, covering Azure OpenAI or AI Foundry, AKS and Functions, or the equivalent on AWS or GCP. Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform or Bicep, CI/CD and API design.
* Data foundations, including SQL, Spark or Databricks, vector stores, and real experience working with messy unstructured technical documents.
* Prior delivery of technology for an R\&D, scientific or laboratory function in CPG, food and beverage, pharma, chemicals, flavors and fragrances, agriculture or materials science.

A test is focused on answering a specific objective and has a pre\-defined pass/fail criteria.” Compliance testing may include activities such as automated surveillance and transaction level testing and may be performed onsite. title: Senior Application QA
description:
**Roboyo AI is a category shaper in Applied AI and Agentic Automation.**

 We help leading enterprises move from automation projects and AI experiments into governed, production\-grade systems that execute real work across workflows, processes, products and services.
 

  
 





 Our heritage is in scaled enterprise automation; our future is Applied AI and Agentic Automation: autonomous agents, AI engineering squads, process orchestration, data and knowledge foundations, and human\-in\-the\-loop governance embedded deeply into how our clients operate.
 

  
 





 We are not here to sell AI theatre. We are here to turn AI into working systems, measurable outcomes and repeatable transformation programs.
 

  
 




  
 



**About the role:** 





 We are seeking an experienced and hands\-on 
 
**Senior Application QA**

  to join our growing Quality Engineering team supporting a major UK Financial Services client.
 

  
 





 This role is responsible for ensuring the quality of enterprise applications developed using the Appian platform through a combination of manual testing, automation, quality engineering practices and collaboration across the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).
 

  
 





 As a Senior QA, you will work closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Developers, DevOps Engineers and Business Stakeholders to deliver robust, reliable and high\-quality software. You will contribute to the design and execution of testing strategies, build and maintain automation frameworks, participate in release activities, and help continuously improve our overall quality engineering capability.
 

  
 





 This is a highly hands\-on role requiring excellent technical skills, strong analytical thinking and a proactive approach to quality.
 

  
 




  
 



**Key Responsibilities**






 Quality Engineering \& Test Strategy
 


  
 



* Contribute to the definition and continuous improvement of QA strategy, testing standards and quality engineering practices.


* Promote Shift\-Left testing by participating in requirements analysis, backlog refinement and solution design sessions.


* Review business and technical requirements to ensure they are testable and complete.


* Identify quality risks early and recommend mitigation strategies.


* Support the establishment and maintenance of quality gates throughout the delivery lifecycle.




  
 


 Manual Testing
 


  
 



* Design, prepare and execute comprehensive manual test cases and test scenarios.


* Perform:


* Functional Testing


* Integration Testing


* System Testing


* End\-to\-End Testing


* Regression Testing


* User Acceptance Testing (UAT) support


* Exploratory Testing


* Smoke and Sanity Testing


* Validate business processes, workflows and application behaviour.


* Execute testing across multiple environments and browsers where applicable.


* Ensure all testing evidence is accurately recorded.


* environments.





 API \& Integration Testing
 


  
 



* Validate RESTful APIs and system integrations.


* Perform request and response validation.


* Verify authentication, authorisation and error handling.


* Support testing of integrations between Appian and third\-party platforms.
* Analyse logs and API responses to support troubleshooting and defect investigation.





 Test Planning \& Delivery
 


  
 



* Participate in Sprint Planning, backlog refinement and estimation sessions.


* Prepare test plans, test scenarios and execution schedules.


* Estimate testing effort for new functionality.


* Maintain full traceability between requirements, test cases and defects.


* Support delivery planning across multiple releases.





 Defect Management
 


  
 



* Identify, document and manage software defects throughout their lifecycle.


* Perform root cause analysis alongside development teams.


* Validate defect fixes and regression impacts.


* Ensure defects contain sufficient evidence for efficient investigation.


* Monitor defect trends and recommend process improvements.





 CI/CD \& DevOps
 


  
 



* Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.


* Support continuous testing practices.


* Execute automated smoke tests following deployments.


* Support release validation activities.


* Help improve deployment quality through automation.





 Production \& Release Support
 


  
 



* Participate in release readiness activities.


* Perform post\-deployment validation.


* Support investigation of production incidents.


* Assist with root cause analysis and hotfix validation.


* Support production release sign\-off where appropriate.





 Test Data \& Environment Management

* Coordinate environment readiness for testing activities.


* Support environment troubleshooting.


* Ensure data integrity throughout testing.

* Compatibility Testing


* Security Testing




 Working alongside specialist teams where required.

 Continuous Improvement

* Share knowledge and best practices across the team.
